info.headline: Damaging Winds
info.description: - Localised disruption of small harbours and/or a port for a short period of time - Difficulty in navigation (eg. Hampered progress due to strong winds) - Small vessels at risk of taking on water and capsizing in a locality. - Localised disruptions to beachfront activities. - Localised damage to settlements (formal and informal). - Localised problems for high-sided vehicles on prone routes.
info.instruction: Small to medium boats are advised to stay away from the open sea and seek the shelter of a harbour. In the harbour, moor the boats properly with ample fenders. Avoid going to beaches. Drive with caution, especially high-sided vehicles and trucks. Secure or bring indoors loose items such as chairs, bins, signs and roof sheets.
